data.name: labelSaveFormation.Text
data.value: This will save the formation in the game and use it for other functions in the trainer

data.name: labelStayInFormation.Text
data.value: Whether saved formation has effect on finding best fit for players or rotating them

data.name: labelChangeToBestPosition.Text
data.value: Change Players to their best rating position if possible

data.name: labelRotateByEnergy.Text
data.value: Rotate players by energy (a seldom used goalkeeper may play out of place)

data.name: labelRotateByAbility.Text
data.value: Rotate players by ratings (a tired player may be left on the starting lineup)

data.name: labelMaxMoral.Text
data.value: Lock Moral to max value, the players may thank you.

data.name: labelMaxStrength.Text
data.value: Max Strength for full team, less injuries.

data.name: labelCnvertToGK.Text
data.value: Minimize training injuries by converting subs to GK. Don't worry, the schedule is unchanged, and their retirement threats are empty if you perform Auto Position at the end of the season.

data.name: labelComputerBoost.Text
data.value: Computers don't train so the games becomes less and less competitive after a while. Here are some changes to make up for that.

data.name: labelBoostYouthPlayers.Text
data.value: Attributes of new spawned players are increased by 25

data.name: labelBoostAllPlayersBy1.Text
data.value: Attributes of all players are increased by 1

data.name: labelExportPlayerData.Text
data.value: Export Player Data as CSV file. You can then use programs like Excel to do data analysis or import after editing.

data.name: labelImportPlayerData.Text
data.value: Import player data after editing. Match is based on name, so don't change names.

data.name: labelCopyPlayerData.Text
data.value: Save player data for a paste. This can be used to save the attributes of a retiring player at the end of the season.

data.name: labelPastePlayerData.Text
data.value: Paste saved player data. This can be used to restore saved attributes to a new spawn at the begining of a season.

data.name: labelEvilYoungPlayers.Text
data.value: Evaluate young players on other teams for scouting purposes

data.name: labelPurchaseLand.Text
data.value: Your stadium can now expand to roads and rivers!

data.name: labelTimeTravel.Text
data.value: In year 2079 the game's age storage will overflow, causing a serious of issues and eventrualy freeze the game. Go back in time to play normally. You should only use time travel during offseason or it would corrupt the game schduling system and you have no match to play anymore.

data.name: labelRestartGame.Text
data.value: This game autosaves on closing. If you are hit by a bug such as the #40 player overflow, you want to restart the game without saving. This is also a way to get out of the game asking for cd constantly without task manager.

data.name: labelUpdateNewSpawn.Text
data.value: Every season some player retire and got replaced by new spawns with the same last name and random first names. This would inject some fresh data from WikiPedia. Or old and obselete data if you time travel first. If you are only interested in a subset, like AC Milan players, specify in the dropdown. This should only be used at the begining of a season.
